description: T-5265: references to a deleted sheet through a row insert above the referenced rows on another sheet. Sheets in order F, S, Third: S!C4:C7 hold 1,2,4,8 and Third!C4:C7 10,20,40,80. delete_sheet S (Third then takes S's place in the sheet order), then insert_row 2 on Third, above rows 4-7. Do the references to the missing sheet keep their rows? Sheet F holds A1 =SUM(S!C4:C7), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =S!C4+1, A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!$C$4:$C$7), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), A7 =SUM(Third!C4:C7) (the control: it shifts to Third!C5:C8), A8 FORMULATEXT(A7).
